items.author: Musk
items.text: Musk Says A Tesla-SpaceX Merger Is "A Good Idea," But Admits It Would Require 1.98 Billion "Yes" Votes. He Calls It "Quite A High Hurdle"
items.summary_cn: Musk 称 Tesla 与 SpaceX 合并是一个“好主意”，但承认需要获得约19.8亿张赞成票，显示其对两家公司整合持方向性支持但面临很高门槛。

items.author: 段永平
items.text: 泡泡瑪特市值蒸發2700億港元，段永平浮虧超18億港元
items.summary_cn: 据香港媒体报道，泡泡玛特市值蒸发约2700亿港元，段永平据报浮亏超过18亿港元，显示市场正显著下调其消费与潮玩业务预期。

items.author: Cathie Wood
items.text: ARK Invest (Cathie Wood/木头姐) 2026-10-28 调仓：Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited(TSM) 卖出 ARKQ 7,491 股 / ARKX 3,224 股（最大单只 ETF 占比 0.20%）
items.summary_cn: ARK Invest 于10月28日减持台积电，ARKQ 中占比0.20%，属于规模较明显的晶圆代工持仓减仓。

items.author: 段永平
items.text: 連巴菲特都想看他部落格！段永平重倉蘋果暴賺16倍：曾慘賠數億美金，回頭來看都違背股神告誡「3大禁忌」
items.summary_cn: 据媒体转述，段永平长期重仓 Apple 并获得约16倍收益，其经历被视为对长期持有优质龙头的正面背书。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Musk’s Favorite Ticker Is Free for Taking in a SpaceX-Tesla Deal
items.summary_cn: 媒体称 Musk 对 Tesla 的偏好使该股成为 SpaceX-Tesla 交易中的潜在“货币”，对 TSLA 构成偏多关注。

items.author: Burry
items.text: Michael Burry says Anthropic's IPO filing proves the AI boom is dangerously exposed
items.summary_cn: 据报道，Michael Burry 认为 Anthropic 的 IPO 文件证明 AI 热潮存在危险暴露，公开警告整个 AI 估值体系可能极度脆弱。

items.author: Musk
items.text: SpaceX closes $40 billion debt deal for AI chips, Elon Musk says
items.summary_cn: Musk 表示 SpaceX 已完成400亿美元债务融资以采购 AI 芯片，反映其继续大规模扩张算力基础设施及资本需求。

items.author: 洪灏
items.text: 私募大佬但斌：AI不信是泡沬
items.summary_cn: 私募大佬但斌公开表达对 AI 泡沫的怀疑，释放看空部分高估值 AI 资产及商业化预期的信号。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Why Anthropic's IPO contrasts the 'cult of Elon Musk' at SpaceX and Tesla
items.summary_cn: 媒体将 Anthropic 的 IPO 路线与 Musk 主导的 SpaceX、Tesla 对比，显示资本市场正在关注 AI 公司独立上市与 Musk 体系内企业模式的差异。

items.author: Musk
items.text: There’s a New Wildcard Haunting Telecom Earnings: Elon Musk’s SpaceX
items.summary_cn: 媒体称 SpaceX 正成为电信运营商业绩的新威胁，卫星通信竞争可能对传统电信企业的增长预期形成压力。

items.author: Burry
items.text: Michael Burry followed Anthropic’s cash and saw familiar names
items.summary_cn: 据报道，Michael Burry 追踪 Anthropic 的现金及关联公司后认为其投资结构中存在熟悉的风险迹象，对他仍是偏空观点。

items.author: Musk
items.text: ‘Elonville’: US residents say Musk’s xAI offered to buy homes if they don’t sue over datacenter noise
items.summary_cn: 据报道，Musk 旗下 xAI 为避免数据中心噪声诉讼而提出收购附近住宅，凸显 AI 数据中心扩张带来的社区及监管矛盾。

items.author: 洪灏
items.text: 美伊領袖均謂不願「非戰非和」！
items.summary_cn: 据报道，美国与伊朗领导人均表示不愿陷入“非战非和”状态，意味着地缘风险有所缓和但冲突尾部风险仍未消除。

items.author: Trump
items.text: Congressman Dan Meuser is an America First Patriot who is doing an incredible job representing Pennsylvania’s 9th Congressional District!A very successful Businessman, former Secretary of Revenue of Pennsylvania, and now, as U.S. Congressman, Dan has strongly served his Community with a career “loaded up” with accolades and wins. In Congress, he is working hard to Grow our Economy, Cut Taxes and Regulations, Promote MADE IN THE U.S.A., Unleash American Energy DOMINANCE, Keep our Border SECURE, Stop Migrant Crime, Strengthen our Military/Veterans, and Protect our always under siege Second Amend
items.summary_cn: Trump 宣称其支持者正推动增长经济、削减税收和监管、强化美国制造及能源优势，释放温和利好美国制造业和能源的信号。

items.author: Pelosi
items.text: Top independent power producers: Scotiabank picks
items.summary_cn: 据报道，Scotiabank 看好独立发电商板块，反映研究机构对电力需求及独立发电企业盈利前景的积极判断。

items.author: Trump
items.text: TO THE GREAT PEOPLE OF ALASKA, GET OUT AND VOTE FOR DAN S. SULLIVAN!   Senator Dan S. Sullivan is doing a fantastic job representing the Great State of Alaska! Prior to becoming a very distinguished and Highly Respected Senator, Dan served as State Attorney General and the Commissioner of the Alaska Department of Natural Resources.   Dan is a GREAT man, has ALWAYS delivered for Alaska (which I won three times by BIG margins in 2016, 2020, and 2024!), and will continue doing so in the U.S. Senate. No one has done more for Alaska than “TRUMP,” including securing 11 new Arctic Security Cutter Ice
items.summary_cn: Trump 为阿拉斯加州参议员 Dan Sullivan 背书，并提及增加北极安全破冰船，体现对阿拉斯加资源与国防项目的高度重视。
